name: Nekar Samman Yojana
benefit: The assistance of Rs.2000/- is transferred to the beneficiaries through the mode of Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) modeFinancial assistance to registered handloom weavers under the "Nekara Samman Yojana" has been increased from Rs 2,000 to Rs 5,000 as per the budget for 2022-23.
eligibility_rules: The beneficiary must be a resident of Karnataka. They must have a valid resident certificate. All the weavers and financially distressed workers engaged in the handloom/ power loom industry and ancillary activities such as cotton, wool, and silk in the state are eligible. Prospective beneficiaries must have an active bank account.
documents_required: documentsAadhaar CardRation CardProof of ResidentBank Account detailsIncome DetailsPhotographMobile NumberOther requisite
how_to_apply: Mode: Online Application ProcessFirst Applicant needs to go to the official website of the Government of Karnataka. Then choose Covid-related services and signup. Fill out the Nekar Samman Yojane online registration form and submit it to get the plan benefits.
